# Synthetic failure capture after the Luna public-act consistency fix

Source commit b2c566b9508ba4c6a47809d659d934aa15f40a2c (Luna participant path: agree needs an unrevoked public name source, name acts withheld from the ledger unless the name is shown, Luna-only generator text; on main 0fe6e52). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the adopted failure-path-memory-default-8e8910b capture, records differ only at 26 leaves: 15 run IDs, 10 instruction-source hash leaves (`v2/dialogue-v2.mjs` and `v2/generation-guard.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. The source map also changes for `judgment/luna.mjs`, `judgment/memory.mjs` and the new `judgment/name-evidence.mjs`; records are identical (apart from run IDs) to the interim 5e28a2c capture this replaces. These failure paths run the Jev pipeline, whose generator text is unchanged, so request payloads, behavior, schema, failure, clocks, policy, calls/sends and storage are unchanged. Existing 3 run-ID exclusions are unchanged. Metadata records the actual base commit instead of the generator's historical `3071720` literal.

Earlier fixture directories remain byte-identical. Only the current provenance target URL and its baseCommit literal move. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
